rival_explanations: A generic phrase-continuation head that fires on any token continuing a multi-word phrase regardless of anchor distinctiveness, so common-word prose like 'Travel time from Sinsen to Stortinget' or 'the girl near the park' fires just as strongly.

A strict previous-token copier where each firing token only attends to the immediately preceding token, so '(' attends '325', 'of' attends 'city', and the scan's 30-200-token reaches are measurement noise.
